TARGET_AUDIENCE: Urban professionals aged 23-30 living in Bengaluru or Hyderabad taking a spontaneous 48-hour weekend trip to Chennai with a friend, who have saved food reels and beach spots but keep losing track of shared auto fares and itinerary notes in messy WhatsApp threads.
PAIN_POINT: On a packed 48-hour Chennai weekend, constantly switching between cash and UPI for ten different auto rides from Mylapore to Besant Nagar, splitting chaotic street food bills, and losing track of temple dress-code checklists in fragmented chat threads turns the short getaway into a constant calculation headache.
DESTINATION: Chennai (Mylapore temple quarter and Marina Beach coastal promenade, Tamil Nadu, India)
CREATIVE_ANGLE: They know they only have two days to pack in filter coffee, temple visits, and beach sunsets, but between constant auto rides across town and shared meal bills, they are spending half their weekend doing math in chat threads. The Travafa Shared Coordination hub tracks every expense balance live and keeps the shared checklist and notes in one place, so they never have to stop the trip to settle who paid for what.
LOOK_CONSTRAINTS: time_of_day: golden hour, warm low-angle sunlight; weather: clear sky, dry conditions; palette: muted pastel tones, low saturation; film_look: handheld documentary feel, minor natural shake; human_presence: two travellers together, friends or partners
HOOK_STYLE: the scene opens on dialogue already in progress between two people, and the camera finds them
PACING_SHAPE: give the problem and escalation more room; compress the product demonstration into a single fast, confident beat
ENDING_STYLE: the character turns directly to camera in the final part and speaks the CTA themselves; the environment is present but secondary
DIALOGUE_DENSITY: concentrate dialogue in the earlier parts; let the later parts lean more on visual action and silence
CharacterStyle: Friend one wears a loose-fitting faded sage-green linen short-sleeve shirt over a crisp white cotton tee and rolled beige chinos with woven slip-on shoes; friend two wears an oversized dusty terracotta cotton overshirt, cream drawstring linen trousers, and thin-rimmed round spectacles with a canvas tote slung over the forearm.
Setting: A sun-warmed paved walkway overlooking the wide sandy stretch of Marina Beach during low-angle golden hour, with faded pastel painted rail guards, coastal haze, and distant silhouettes of catamarans resting on the sand.
ReferenceTone: Warm natural golden hour documentary aesthetic, muted pastel grade with low saturation, gentle handheld realism, intimate candid travel photography vibe.
PhoneShotAction: Holds the phone naturally with one hand at chest height against the golden light, effortlessly tapping to log a shared auto fare into the group expense balance while the other friend leans in to glance at the updated checklist.
